findings.evidence: Row declares version "rtx-pro-6000" with version_status "published". The primary protocol (SPEC.md, leaderboard.json, /cuda page) publishes no release identifier for this board; only schema_version 1, environment v2_containerized, and generated tag v2 appear, and none is a board release identifier. "rtx-pro-6000" is the hardware identity, not a copy of any published release identifier. Under criterion c2, a page publishing no release identifier requires version_status "snapshot" with a snapshot-<date> version.
findings.repair: Set version_status to "snapshot" and version to the dated identity snapshot-<capture-date> (e.g. snapshot-2026-11-11), or supply evidence of a published release identifier that "rtx-pro-6000" copies.

findings.evidence: version_guard says "the problem must stay in the stated four-problem deck", but SPEC.md (2026-11-09) states problem 04 was retired and the deck stays at three; leaderboard.json lists only problems 01, 02, 03. The four-problem reference is stale and contradicts the current protocol.
findings.repair: Change the version_guard to require the problem stays in the three-problem deck (01_glm52_fused_moe, 02_deepseek_nsa, 03_megaqwen_decode) per the current SPEC.

findings.repair: Remove the unsupported problem-04 claims from notes, or replace them with evidence-backed examples from the current three-problem board (e.g., only the 03 suspect cell).
